purpose: Freeze and compile the first one-file MOS receiver and original synthetic fixture; linked startup/object parity checks
resources: one serial native AgonDev compiler/linker; under 1 GiB; no emulator
duration: expected under one minute; hard180s per compiler subprocess and540s total tranche
cleanup: join only owned compiler children, retain failed freezes and logs, release and steer successor

policy.builds: Automatically granted FIFO, one compile job at a time; no manager approval or 10% CPU gate.
policy.baseload: Robocode/Tank Royale server, including active matches, needs no reservation or routine start/end/informational notification to Pi5 manager and does not occupy or block the shared slot or compilation. Separate substantial workloads and physical bench/test permissions remain unchanged; paused work is not resumed.
policy.routing: Reserve Oryx for emulator runs and Pi5 for compiler work. When the required build is not possible on Pi5, compiler work may use the existing Oryx self-service FIFO without another routing approval; record the concrete architecture/toolchain limitation, not merely queue congestion. Extender schedules live-serial hardware qualification/benchmark/debug bench access; Console8/manual or semi-automated runs remain at Author discretion.
policy.heavy: Pi emulator exceptions need specific new Author approval; CFD/solvers and other heavy Pi work retain explicit Author authorization, manager admission, and start/end chat notices to pi5-manager. Native services are separately classified.
policy.build_cleanup: After owned children stop, release using --work-stopped --cleanup-complete; no manager handback or host-wide quiet test.
policy.authorization_limit: A supplied record documents authorization; this same-account helper cannot authenticate human authorship.

release_observation.disposition: Owner confirms all owned build children stopped and cleanup complete; no global quiet claim

automatic_build_grant.purpose: Serial native UBSan cache/persistence fault checks and eZ80 object cross-compile; no emulator
automatic_build_grant.resources: One compiler/check child at a time, under512MiB
automatic_build_grant.cleanup: Join own children, preserve logs and release immediately
